    How the restatement works

    Every restated figure starts from NAREIT FFO, the industry-standard measure, and then applies each adjustment the company made toward its own "core" figure according to the rule you choose for that type: remove it as the company did, keep costs in earnings but remove gains, or keep it in earnings entirely. AFFO then deducts recurring capital expenditures, taken from the company's capex table when its own AFFO leaves them out (both options can be switched off).

    GAAP figures (EPS, revenue, dividends, debt, assets) come from the XBRL data in each company's 10-Q and 10-K. Fourth quarters appear only in the annual 10-K, so Q4 is the full year minus the first nine months; for per-share figures that is approximate and marked ≈.

    Data: 17 REITs, 250 company-quarters (Q1 2022–Q3 2026), extracted from SEC EDGAR filings and checked against each company's reported totals. Page numbers are the printed page numbers in the linked exhibit. Built November 24, 2026. Not investment advice.
